data: {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"result":{"tools":[{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Assets Â· Profile"},"description":"An asset's core profile by symbol: name, category and cross-system
        identifiers (CoinGecko id, contract addresses, chains).

        Start here when you have a ticker and need to be sure which asset it
        refers to. Tickers collide across chains â if the symbol is ambiguous,
        resolve_ticker is the tool that says so instead of guessing.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"symbol":{"title":"Symbol","type":"string"}},"required":["symbol"],"type":"object","title":"get_assetArguments"},"name":"get_asset","title":"Assets Â· Profile"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Scores Â· Asset breakdown"},"description":"An asset's Galaxy Score and AltRank, with the components behind each.

        Galaxy Score is a composite of social and market health on a 0-100
        scale; AltRank is relative standing against the rest of the universe,
        where 1 is best. READ THE COMPONENT BREAKDOWN â a score moved by
        sentiment and one moved by volume mean different things, and the
        composite alone cannot tell you which happened.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"symbol":{"title":"Symbol","type":"string"}},"required":["symbol"],"type":"object","title":"get_asset_scoresArguments"},"name":"get_asset_scores","title":"Scores Â· Asset breakdown"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Fundamentals Â· Full brief"},"description":"Get the full fundamental brief for an asset: market snapshot, supply
        and valuation, project, TVL, revenue, treasury, security, governance,
        unlock schedule, derivatives positioning, competitive rank, valuation
        ratios and a graded scorecard â in one call.

        READ THE SECTION STATES, NOT ONLY THE VALUES. Each section is
        `measured`, `not_held` or `failed`, and sections the asset class cannot
        have are returned separately in `not_applicable`. "This chain has no
        DAO treasury" and "we could not read it" are different facts and this
        response keeps them apart.

        Revenue is split: `S06` is the entity's own fees, `S06b` is the total
        earned by protocols deployed on a chain. The two can differ by two
        orders of magnitude and only the first accrues to the token.
        ","inputSchema":{"properties":{"symbol":{"title":"Symbol","type":"string"}},"required":["symbol"],"type":"object","title":"get_asset_fundamentalsArguments"},"name":"get_asset_fundamentals","title":"Fundamentals Â· Full brief"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Fundamentals Â· Technical levels"},"description":"Get support and resistance merged across 1w/1d/4h/1h, per-timeframe
        indicators, and derived spot/long/short setups for an asset.

        Each level carries the timeframes that confirmed it and the method on
        each â a level agreed by four charts is a different claim from one seen
        on the hourly. `measured_against` names the exchange and pair every
        distance was computed from, and `price_age_minutes` says how old that
        price is.

        Setups are GEOMETRY, not forecasts: an entry is a level cluster, a stop
        is that level offset by a measured multiple of daily range, and
        `rr_ratio` is computed from those prices. `status` is derived per
        request â pending, in_zone or passed.
        ","inputSchema":{"properties":{"symbol":{"title":"Symbol","type":"string"},"limit":{"default":8,"title":"Limit","type":"integer"}},"required":["symbol"],"type":"object","title":"get_asset_technicalsArguments"},"name":"get_asset_technicals","title":"Fundamentals Â· Technical levels"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Scores Â· Top by Galaxy Score"},"description":"The assets with the strongest Galaxy Score right now.

        Galaxy Score is 0-100 and composite: social volume, engagement,
        sentiment and market health folded together. A high score is a
        statement about ATTENTION AND HEALTH, not about valuation â it does not
        mean an asset is cheap. Call get_asset_scores for the breakdown.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"limit":{"default":10,"title":"Limit","type":"integer"}},"type":"object","title":"get_top_galaxy_scoresArguments"},"name":"get_top_galaxy_scores","title":"Scores Â· Top by Galaxy Score"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Scores Â· Top by AltRank"},"description":"The assets ranked best by AltRank right now â relative standing, not absolute.

        AltRank is a RANK: 1 is the strongest in the universe. A rising AltRank
        in a falling market means outperforming the fall, not going up. Pair
        with get_asset_scores when the distinction matters.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"limit":{"default":10,"title":"Limit","type":"integer"}},"type":"object","title":"get_top_altranksArguments"},"name":"get_top_altranks","title":"Scores Â· Top by AltRank"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Analytics Â· Social-price correlation"},"description":"How closely an asset's social activity tracks its price, with the lead/lag.

        Correlation is not causation and this endpoint does not claim it is. A
        high coefficient says the two series moved together over the window â
        it does not say which one moved first. Use get_leading_indicators for
        that question.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"symbol":{"title":"Symbol","type":"string"}},"required":["symbol"],"type":"object","title":"get_correlationArguments"},"name":"get_correlation","title":"Analytics Â· Social-price correlation"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Analytics Â· Leading indicators"},"description":"Which social and on-chain signals have historically MOVED FIRST for an asset.

        This is the lead/lag question that get_correlation deliberately does not
        answer. A lead measured over a past window is not a forecast and the
        response does not present it as one â it is the observed ordering of two
        series, and it can break.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"symbol":{"title":"Symbol","type":"string"}},"required":["symbol"],"type":"object","title":"get_leading_indicatorsArguments"},"name":"get_leading_indicators","title":"Analytics Â· Leading indicators"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Social Â· Share of conversation"},"description":"Each asset's SHARE of total social attention over a window, with the posts,
        distinct authors, engagement and sentiment behind the share.

        Share is relative and sums across the universe, so an asset's dominance
        can fall while its absolute volume rises â that is the market getting
        louder, not the asset getting quieter. Distinct authors is the column
        that separates a real conversation from one account posting 400 times.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"hours":{"default":168,"title":"Hours","type":"integer"}},"type":"object","title":"get_social_dominanceArguments"},"name":"get_social_dominance","title":"Social Â· Share of conversation"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Social Â· Topic rank"},"description":"Rank what the market is TALKING ABOUT â themes and narratives, not assets.

        Ranked by mentions weighted by engagement over the window, so a topic
        posted about loudly by few accounts does not outrank one discussed
        widely. Use get_trending_assets for tickers; this is the layer above,
        where "restaking" and "AI agents" live.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"hours":{"default":168,"title":"Hours","type":"integer"},"limit":{"default":10,"title":"Limit","type":"integer"}},"type":"object","title":"get_topic_rankArguments"},"name":"get_topic_rank","title":"Social Â· Topic rank"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"On-chain Â· Whale transactions"},"description":"Recent large on-chain transfers, optionally filtered to one asset.

        "Whale" is a SIZE threshold, not an identity. A large transfer is very
        often an exchange moving its own funds between wallets, which is not a
        market action at all â counterparty labels are included where we hold
        them, and a null label means WE HAVE NO LABEL, never that the
        counterparty is unknown or safe.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"limit":{"default":25,"title":"Limit","type":"integer"},"symbol":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null,"title":"Symbol"}},"type":"object","title":"get_whale_transactionsArguments"},"name":"get_whale_transactions","title":"On-chain Â· Whale transactions"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"On-chain Â· Exchange flows"},"description":"Net movement of an asset into and out of exchange wallets.

        Inflows are supply arriving somewhere it can be sold; outflows are
        supply leaving to self-custody. The conventional reading is
        distribution vs accumulation, but a single large transfer can be an
        exchange rebalancing its own wallets â check get_entity_flows before
        attributing intent.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"symbol":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}],"default":null,"title":"Symbol"}},"type":"object","title":"get_exchange_flowsArguments"},"name":"get_exchange_flows","title":"On-chain Â· Exchange flows"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Sentiment Â· By aspect"},"description":"Split an asset's sentiment by what people are actually talking about:
        technology, price, team and community.

        The aggregate can be flat while the parts disagree sharply â bullish on
        technology, bearish on team is a different situation from uniformly
        neutral, and only this tool can tell them apart.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"asset":{"title":"Asset","type":"string"}},"required":["asset"],"type":"object","title":"get_aspect_sentimentArguments"},"name":"get_aspect_sentiment","title":"Sentiment Â· By aspect"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Sentiment Â· Score arbitrary text"},"description":"Score any text for crypto sentiment, tuned for crypto slang and tickers.

        Takes arbitrary text you supply â it does not look anything up. General
        sentiment models read "this is going to zero" and "wagmi" badly; this
        one is fitted to the register. Returns polarity plus the terms that
        drove it, so a score can be checked rather than trusted.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"text":{"title":"Text","type":"string"}},"required":["text"],"type":"object","title":"analyze_sentimentArguments"},"name":"analyze_sentiment","title":"Sentiment Â· Score arbitrary text"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Social Â· Influencers by asset"},"description":"The accounts driving conversation about one asset, by reach and engagement.

        Ranked by measured activity in our corpus, NOT by follower count, and
        NOT by whether they were right â see get_influencer_ledger for track
        record. A large account posting noise ranks here; that is the point of
        keeping the two tools separate.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"asset":{"title":"Asset","type":"string"}},"required":["asset"],"type":"object","title":"get_influencersArguments"},"name":"get_influencers","title":"Social Â· Influencers by asset"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Signal integrity Â· Real-vs-fake score"},"description":"Get the Signal Integrity score (0-100) â is the move real or exit liquidity?
        Fuses social authenticity + on-chain reality + fundamental backing, with an
        Exit Liquidity Radar flag.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"symbol":{"title":"Symbol","type":"string"}},"required":["symbol"],"type":"object","title":"get_signal_integrityArguments"},"name":"get_signal_integrity","title":"Signal integrity Â· Real-vs-fake score"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Influencer ledger Â· Track record"},"description":"Get an influencer's accountability record: did their calls precede the move
        (Predictor) or react to it (Reactor)? Includes hit rate and track record.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"influencer_id":{"title":"Influencer Id","type":"string"}},"required":["influencer_id"],"type":"object","title":"get_influencer_ledgerArguments"},"name":"get_influencer_ledger","title":"Influencer ledger Â· Track record"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Influencer ledger Â· Leaderboard"},"description":"The influencer accountability leaderboard, ranked by what people actually
        got RIGHT rather than by how loud they are.

        Each entry is scored Predictor vs Reactor: did the call come before the
        move, or after it. This is the flagship differentiator â reach and
        accuracy are different axes, and most rankings only publish the first.","inputSchema":{"properties":{},"type":"object","title":"get_influencer_leaderboardArguments"},"name":"get_influencer_leaderboard","title":"Influencer ledger Â· Leaderboard"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Assets Â· Search"},"description":"Search the whole asset universe (~1,900 assets) by symbol or name.
        Use this to resolve a user's loose reference into a real symbol before
        calling the other tools.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"query":{"title":"Query","type":"string"},"limit":{"default":20,"title":"Limit","type":"integer"}},"required":["query"],"type":"object","title":"search_assetsArguments"},"name":"search_assets","title":"Assets Â· Search"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Coverage Â· Data"},"description":"What data this platform actually holds right now: asset count, how many
        are priced, chains covered, labelled addresses, social corpus size, and
        freshness timestamps. Call this to check whether an answer is supportable
        before asserting it.","inputSchema":{"properties":{},"type":"object","title":"get_data_coverageArguments"},"name":"get_data_coverage","title":"Coverage Â· Data"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Coverage Â· Chains"},"description":"Per-chain coverage â tokens mapped, labelled addresses, whale
        transactions seen, and how many were attributed to a named entity.
        Attribution is Etherscan-derived, so it is strong on Ethereum and sparse
        on other chains.","inputSchema":{"properties":{},"type":"object","title":"get_chain_coverageArguments"},"name":"get_chain_coverage","title":"Coverage Â· Chains"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Assets Â· Contract addresses"},"description":"Every chain an asset is deployed on, with its contract address and
        token decimals.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"symbol":{"title":"Symbol","type":"string"}},"required":["symbol"],"type":"object","title":"get_asset_platformsArguments"},"name":"get_asset_platforms","title":"Assets Â· Contract addresses"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"On-chain Â· Address lookup"},"description":"Identify a blockchain address â exchange, bridge, DEX, MEV bot, mining
        pool, or OFAC-sanctioned â with the source and confidence of each label.
        IMPORTANT: `known: false` means no label is held. It does NOT mean the
        address is clean or unflagged.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"address":{"title":"Address","type":"string"}},"required":["address"],"type":"object","title":"lookup_addressArguments"},"name":"lookup_address","title":"On-chain Â· Address lookup"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"On-chain Â· Labelled addresses"},"description":"Browse labelled addresses, filtered by chain, entity (e.g. Binance) or
        category (exchange | bridge | dex | mev | staking | mining | sanctioned).","inputSchema":{"properties":{"chain":{"default":"","title":"Chain","type":"string"},"entity":{"default":"","title":"Entity","type":"string"},"category":{"default":"","title":"Category","type":"string"},"limit":{"default":50,"title":"Limit","type":"integer"}},"type":"object","title":"list_labelled_addressesArguments"},"name":"list_labelled_addresses","title":"On-chain Â· Labelled addresses"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Metrics Â· Catalogue"},"description":"List every metric Onvexia knows, with its parity and caveats.

        parity=exact means we compute it the way Santiment does; approximate means
        same concept but different coverage or method (read the caveat before
        relying on the number); unavailable means we do NOT serve it yet.
        Unavailable metrics are listed on purpose â check here before asserting
        that Onvexia can answer a question.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"category":{"default":"","title":"Category","type":"string"},"available_only":{"default":false,"title":"Available Only","type":"boolean"}},"type":"object","title":"list_metricsArguments"},"name":"list_metrics","title":"Metrics Â· Catalogue"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Metrics Â· Metadata"},"description":"Describe one metric before you use it: parity, category, minimum interval
        and any caveat attached to it.

        CALL THIS BEFORE get_metric_timeseries if the metric is unfamiliar. The
        minimum interval tells you the finest resolution that is real rather
        than interpolated, and the caveat is where an approximate metric admits
        what it approximates.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"metric":{"title":"Metric","type":"string"}},"required":["metric"],"type":"object","title":"get_metric_metadataArguments"},"name":"get_metric_metadata","title":"Metrics Â· Metadata"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Metrics Â· Timeseries"},"description":"Timeseries for any available metric on any asset.

        Accepts Santiment-style relative dates ("utc_now-7d") as well as ISO
        timestamps. If the metric is not available this returns an error naming it
        rather than an empty series â an empty result here always means "no data in
        that range", never "we do not have this metric".","inputSchema":{"properties":{"metric":{"title":"Metric","type":"string"},"asset":{"title":"Asset","type":"string"},"from_date":{"default":"utc_now-30d","title":"From Date","type":"string"},"to_date":{"default":"utc_now","title":"To Date","type":"string"},"interval":{"default":"1d","title":"Interval","type":"string"},"aggregation":{"default":"LAST","title":"Aggregation","type":"string"}},"required":["metric","asset"],"type":"object","title":"get_metric_timeseriesArguments"},"name":"get_metric_timeseries","title":"Metrics Â· Timeseries"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"On-chain Â· Entity flows"},"description":"Whale flow per labelled entity over the window. Inflow to an exchange
        is distribution pressure; outflow is accumulation.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"hours":{"default":168,"title":"Hours","type":"integer"},"limit":{"default":20,"title":"Limit","type":"integer"}},"type":"object","title":"get_entity_flowsArguments"},"name":"get_entity_flows","title":"On-chain Â· Entity flows"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Metrics Â· Timeseries (multi-asset)"},"description":"Timeseries for ONE metric across MANY assets in a single call.

        `assets` is comma-separated (e.g. "BTC,ETH,SOL"). Prefer this over
        looping get_metric_timeseries â it is one round trip instead of N, and
        the values are guaranteed to come from the same read.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"metric":{"title":"Metric","type":"string"},"assets":{"title":"Assets","type":"string"},"from_date":{"default":"utc_now-30d","title":"From Date","type":"string"},"to_date":{"default":"utc_now","title":"To Date","type":"string"},"interval":{"default":"1d","title":"Interval","type":"string"}},"required":["metric","assets"],"type":"object","title":"get_metric_timeseries_multiArguments"},"name":"get_metric_timeseries_multi","title":"Metrics Â· Timeseries (multi-asset)"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Metrics Â· Batch"},"description":"Latest value of MANY metrics for ONE asset in a single call.
        `metrics` is comma-separated. The mirror of get_metric_timeseries_multi.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"metrics":{"title":"Metrics","type":"string"},"asset":{"title":"Asset","type":"string"}},"required":["metrics","asset"],"type":"object","title":"get_metrics_batchArguments"},"name":"get_metrics_batch","title":"Metrics Â· Batch"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Screener Â· Run screen"},"description":"Filter the whole asset universe server-side and return the matches.

        `filter` is comma-separated `field:op:value` terms, e.g.
        "market_cap:gt:1000000000,funding_rate:lt:0" â assets over $1B whose
        funding rate is negative. Ops: gt, gte, lt, lte, eq, ne.
        Call screener_fields() first to see what fields exist and their ranges;
        guessing a field name gets the whole query rejected.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"filter":{"default":"","title":"Filter","type":"string"},"sort":{"default":"","title":"Sort","type":"string"},"limit":{"default":50,"title":"Limit","type":"integer"}},"type":"object","title":"screen_assetsArguments"},"name":"screen_assets","title":"Screener Â· Run screen"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Screener Â· Available fields"},"description":"Every field the screener accepts, with type and description. Call this
        before building a filter rather than guessing field names.","inputSchema":{"properties":{},"type":"object","title":"screener_fieldsArguments"},"name":"screener_fields","title":"Screener Â· Available fields"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Market Â· OHLCV"},"description":"Daily candles (open/high/low/close/volume) for an asset, with the
        venue they came from. Coverage is bounded by which assets have a USDT
        pair on Binance or Bybit â an asset absent here has no candle source we
        collect, which is not the same as having no price.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"symbol":{"default":"","title":"Symbol","type":"string"},"limit":{"default":100,"title":"Limit","type":"integer"}},"type":"object","title":"get_ohlcvArguments"},"name":"get_ohlcv","title":"Market Â· OHLCV"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Social Â· Trending assets"},"description":"Assets trending now by social activity, with the hype score that
        separates a real move from a burst of noise.","inputSchema":{"properties":{},"type":"object","title":"get_trending_assetsArguments"},"name":"get_trending_assets","title":"Social Â· Trending assets"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Assets Â· Entities"},"description":"Named entities extracted from social documents about an asset â
        people, organisations, products and other tickers mentioned alongside
        it. Use it to find what a narrative is actually about.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"asset":{"title":"Asset","type":"string"}},"required":["asset"],"type":"object","title":"get_entitiesArguments"},"name":"get_entities","title":"Assets Â· Entities"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Sentiment Â· Trends"},"description":"Sentiment over time for an asset, with sample size and confidence
        interval. IMPORTANT: sentiment measured on few documents is unreliable â
        our own bootstrap put the direction wrong 35.6% of the time at n=1 and
        9.5% at n=20. Read n before quoting a direction.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"asset":{"title":"Asset","type":"string"}},"required":["asset"],"type":"object","title":"get_sentiment_trendsArguments"},"name":"get_sentiment_trends","title":"Sentiment Â· Trends"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Signal integrity Â· Bot detections"},"description":"Accounts flagged as automated or coordinated, with the behavioural
        evidence. Volume from these should not be read as organic attention.

        READ `coverage` AND `note` BEFORE YOU READ THE LIST. No scorer is
        currently running, so `bot_probability` is NULL for every account and
        this list comes back EMPTY. An empty list here says nothing whatsoever
        about how clean the corpus is â it means nobody has been scored yet,
        and the response says so explicitly in `note`.

        `coverage.accounts_scored` vs `accounts_total` is the honest number:
        while the first is 0, treat this tool as reporting our coverage, not
        the market's cleanliness.","inputSchema":{"properties":{},"type":"object","title":"get_bot_detectionsArguments"},"name":"get_bot_detections","title":"Signal integrity Â· Bot detections"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Signal integrity Â· Coordinated campaigns"},"description":"Detected coordinated posting campaigns â the same message pushed by
        multiple accounts. Matching is exact-text, so this catches copypasta and
        misses the same campaign reworded.","inputSchema":{"properties":{},"type":"object","title":"get_coordinated_campaignsArguments"},"name":"get_coordinated_campaigns","title":"Signal integrity Â· Coordinated campaigns"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Scores Â· Creator rankings"},"description":"Rank social creators across the whole corpus by measured influence.

        Corpus-wide, unlike get_influencers which is scoped to one asset.
        Influence is computed from engagement our collectors actually observed,
        so a creator we do not ingest is absent rather than ranked low â an
        absence here is a coverage fact, not a judgement.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"limit":{"default":25,"title":"Limit","type":"integer"}},"type":"object","title":"get_creator_rankingsArguments"},"name":"get_creator_rankings","title":"Scores Â· Creator rankings"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Assets Â· Revision history"},"description":"Metrics for this asset that CHANGED after they were first published,
        with the old value, the new one and why. An agent that quoted an earlier
        number can find out here that it moved.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"symbol":{"title":"Symbol","type":"string"}},"required":["symbol"],"type":"object","title":"get_asset_revisionsArguments"},"name":"get_asset_revisions","title":"Assets Â· Revision history"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Narrative Â· Trending stories"},"description":"Current narratives, each an LLM summary of a CLUSTER of posts rather
        than a single document.

        Read author_count before quoting one: a high post_count with a low
        author_count is one person repeating themselves, not a narrative. These
        are machine summaries, not edited articles.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"limit":{"default":20,"title":"Limit","type":"integer"}},"type":"object","title":"get_trending_storiesArguments"},"name":"get_trending_stories","title":"Narrative Â· Trending stories"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Narrative Â· Clusters"},"description":"The raw clusters behind the stories, without the prose â for a model
        doing its own summarisation. Every cluster has >= 2 distinct authors;
        near-identical posts from one account are copypasta and excluded.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"limit":{"default":25,"title":"Limit","type":"integer"}},"type":"object","title":"get_narrative_clustersArguments"},"name":"get_narrative_clusters","title":"Narrative Â· Clusters"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Research Â· Available reports"},"description":"List the assets that currently have a generated research report available.

        Returns the index, not the reports â call get_research_report with a
        symbol for the body. An asset missing from this list has not been
        written up; that is a statement about our coverage, not about the
        asset.","inputSchema":{"properties":{},"type":"object","title":"list_research_reportsArguments"},"name":"list_research_reports","title":"Research Â· Available reports"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Research Â· Report"},"description":"One asset's generated report. The `unavailable` field lists metrics
        the report could NOT use â read it, because a report that silently omits
        funding rate reads as a report about an asset with unremarkable funding.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"symbol":{"title":"Symbol","type":"string"}},"required":["symbol"],"type":"object","title":"get_research_reportArguments"},"name":"get_research_report","title":"Research Â· Report"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Assets Â· Resolve ambiguous ticker"},"description":"Does a bare ticker actually mean the crypto asset?

        verdict 'crypto' means mentions are about the asset; 'equity'/'other'
        means the bare word is dominated by something else (TIA is Spanish
        'tia'; GRT collides with 'graph'). A 404 is NOT a clean bill of health â
        it means nobody has adjudicated that ticker yet.","inputSchema":{"properties":{"ticker":{"title":"Ticker","type":"string"}},"required":["ticker"],"type":"object","title":"resolve_tickerArguments"},"name":"resolve_ticker","title":"Assets Â· Resolve ambiguous ticker"},{"annotations":{"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":true,"readOnlyHint":true,"title":"Coverage Â· Social"},"description":"How many assets actually clear the document floor that makes each
        social metric computable.
